e: Two 2-year postdocs (extendable to a third year) on flavor physics, SMEFT/precision probes and particle cosmology (dark matter, axions, phase transitions, gravitational waves), funded by the SNSF; start Fall 2027. Open to PhDs in theoretical particle physics, cosmology or related fields; no citizenship limits stated.
n: University of Basel: Two postdocs in theoretical particle physics and cosmology (Greljo group)
